question: In which of the following cities was the Paramhansa Mandali founded to work for the abolition of caste?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Paramhansa Mandali** was founded in **1849** in the city of **Bombay** (now Mumbai).
 
• It was one of the earliest socio-religious reform movements in India, aimed at challenging the prevailing **caste system** and promoting equality.
 
• The founders of the Paramhansa Mandali included prominent reformers like **Dadoba Pandurang**, **Mehtaji Durgaram**, and others who were inspired by Enlightenment ideals.
 
• The organization worked to abolish caste discrimination, questioned the **orthodox Hindu practices**, and emphasized the importance of **education** and **rational thinking**.
 
• They held secret meetings to discuss reforms and promote social equality, as their ideas often met resistance from orthodox groups.
